themes_detail.label: Water Quality Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints spiked to 4 this week compared to a 0.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 1500% increase (z-score: 8.66)—suggesting a potential acute contamination or infrastructure failure affecting Far Rockaway's water system this week.
evidence: 4 water quality complaints this week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1500% spike)
Z-score of 8.66 indicates statistically extreme anomaly
Long-standing DEP capital budget requests for sewer infrastructure suggest pre-existing system vulnerabilities
reporting_angles: Interview DEP and local health department about cause of spike; obtain water testing data
Canvass residents about discolored water, taste, odor, or illness complaints
Cross-reference with ongoing Edgemere and Arverne waterfront projects that may affect water systems

themes_detail.label: Tree Die-Off Event
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints exploded to 6 last week versus a 0.5 weekly baseline over 8 weeks—a 1100% spike (z-score: 11.0)—indicating a possible disease outbreak, pest infestation, or environmental stressor affecting the Rockaway landscape this week.
evidence: 6 dead/dying tree complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% spike)
Z-score of 11.0 represents extreme statistical anomaly
Recurring community board requests for park reconstruction and expansion suggest existing environmental stress
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks and NYC Department of Health to identify disease (e.g., oak wilt, hemlock woolly adelgid) or environmental cause
Photo-document affected trees across Rockaway neighborhoods; map geographic pattern
Interview arborists and environmental experts about climate/weather factors (storm damage, salt spray, drought stress)

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Damaged street sign complaints jumped to 21 last week from a 3.0 weekly baseline over 8 weeks—a 600% increase (z-score: 9.98)—pointing to either a storm event or systematic deterioration of Rockaway's street infrastructure this week.
evidence: 21 street sign complaints last week vs. 3.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (600% spike)
Street condition complaints rank #4 overall (1001 total over 90 days), suggesting chronic infrastructure issues
reporting_angles: Determine if spike was triggered by specific weather event (high winds, storm) or represents accelerating deterioration
Request DOT records on street sign maintenance schedules and repair backlogs in Far Rockaway
Check for correlation with construction activity (414 DOB filings in last 90 days, including 235 alterations)

themes_detail.label: Pigeon Infestation Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary pigeon condition complaints tripled to 3 two weeks ago from a 0.4 weekly baseline over 8 weeks—a 700% increase (z-score: 5.42)—indicating emerging pest control or food waste management problems in the district.
evidence: 3 unsanitary pigeon complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike)
Z-score of 5.42 represents statistically significant anomaly
Unsanitary condition complaints are a top-10 category overall (378 total over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Investigate whether spike correlates with increased food waste or construction site exposure
Interview Parks Department and pest management contractors about control efforts
Canvas affected neighborhoods to identify hotspot locations and potential food sources

themes_detail.label: Construction & Plumbing Surge
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints nearly doubled to 17 last week from an 8.0 weekly baseline over 8 weeks—a 112% increase (z-score: 3.67)—coinciding with 414 active DOB building permits and ongoing waterfront development projects.
evidence: 17 construction/plumbing complaints last week vs. 8.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (112% spike)
414 DOB permit filings in last 90 days (235 alterations, 149 new buildings)
Multiple active ULURP/land use projects: Edgemere Commons Phase 2B, 14-10 Beach Channel Drive rezoning, Arverne East Phase 3
reporting_angles: Cross-reference complaint locations with active construction sites to identify non-compliant contractors
Interview residents about noise, dust, water shutoffs, or sidewalk obstruction from ongoing projects
Examine DOB enforcement records for violations on high-complaint sites
